name: checklist
description: A paper chit list: each item gets a blue-ballpoint tick or a red-pen cross, written in sequence. Title sits on the field above the chit. Optional `grow` (default true; false = full-size chit up front): the chit lands holding the first row (never blank) and lengthens downward as each later row is written; the final size is reserved, so the title never shifts. Rows unclip once open, so short shots never cut a row or its pen mark.
